aries: Aug 20, 2026- The fire within you is raging today, Aries, and you should be careful how you wield this power. Be proud and triumphant. Walk with your shoulders back and head high. taurus: Aug 20, 2026- There may be a great deal of fuss over something that seems quite insignificant to you, Taurus. Try to see the beauty and importance of everything around you. gemini: Aug 20, 2026- Things are coming to a critical point for you today, Gemini, and you may find that other people openly object to your actions. cancer: Aug 20, 2026- Feel free to speak more loudly today, Cancer. You'll find that things fall into place more easily if you speak your thoughts outwardly and directly in the presence of others. virgo: Aug 20, 2026- Add more sunshine to your day, Virgo. It may be time to stir up your inner passion and let it speak with greater confidence than you have been lately. capricorn: Aug 20, 2026- Try not to lose sight of your own projects or desires, Capricorn. aquarius: Aug 20, 2026- Recharge today by getting outside and stretching your arms to the sky, Aquarius. Be proud and courageous.
